- Initial release of Signalgrid Push skill.
- Send push notifications to iOS and Android devices via the Signalgrid API.
- Supports customizable notification title, body, type (crit, warn, success, info), and optional critical priority.
- Credentials are supplied via environment variables.

Initial release of signalgrid-push.

- Send push notifications to iOS and Android devices via the Signalgrid API.
- Supports customizable notification parameters: title, body, type (crit, warn, success, info), and critical flag for emergency bypass.
- Command-line script included for sending notifications.
- No phone number required; reads credentials from environment variables.
